title: Warp – Modern Terminal
description: Warp's website presents a modern terminal replacement tool with a clean macOS-inspired design. The hero shows the actual terminal interface with colorful syntax highlighting and IDE-like features visible. Feature sections use animated GIFs showing real workflows — AI command search, block-based editing, split panes. Clean white and blue color scheme creates a sophisticated, professional feel. Developer-first messaging throughout with a focus on productivity improvements. The page uses smooth scroll animations and demonstrates the product's key differentiator: a terminal that feels like a modern IDE rather than a command-line relic.
primary_use_case: Live design inspiration for developer tools reimagining classic interfaces, needing a clean product-focused page with animated workflow demos.
style_vibe: Clean, macOS-inspired developer tool page with animated interface demos and a polished blue and white aesthetic.
